iOS 15 TrollStore refresh from the same shared Flutter source as Windows Build #153. Includes updated Night Mode audio headroom (makeup 1.0), normalized surround downmix, persistent playback effects, player crash recovery, subtitle sync/Apple Speech and latest catalog, UI and library changes. iOS includes native Apple Speech; Windows-only Whisper, DLL updates and Debug Mode checkbox do not apply to iOS. Ad hoc signed for TrollStore; actual device audio behavior remains to be tested.
